LanguageData.BOR_NegotiatorLetterText:
Congratulations! Your researchers have unlocked the Negotiator-class station defense system.
Please read the following before building one:
THIS IS A DANGEROUS CROSS-MAP BOMBARDIER. IT IS NOT DESIGNED FOR USE ON YOUR MAP.
The Cracker shell is, in the technical sense, a nuke. Not "nuke-ish", not "nuke-adjacent". A nuke. The cannon was meant to sit on a station and shoot at other stations from very far away, where the consequences are somebody else's problem.
Aim it at another world tile with a map, ideally one that is not yours, and ideally not one with anything you are fond of on it.
The research team would like it noted that they did say "are you sure?" four times. The warranty does not cover craters, ex-colonists, or "the part where the horizon went white".
Have fun. Stay far away.
